root_idea.summary: The root centers on casting, throwing, or putting something away.
root_idea.development: From physical casting or throwing, the lexicon develops uses for disregarding a covenant, withdrawing apart, describing what has been cast out, designating a small amount, and naming a beverage made by casting ingredients into water.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form.
Displayed under the normalized Form VIII perfect citation form rather than the supplied feminine Quranic inflection.

senses.definition: To cast, throw, or fling something away, to a distance, or into a place.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for physical casting, including casting from the hand, behind oneself, into water or wilderness, and being cast into a place of punishment; the passive forms retain the same lexical sense.

senses.definition: To cast aside, reject, or disregard a covenant, scripture, or binding commitment; in a treaty context, to repudiate the agreement and declare it dissolved to the other party.
senses.usage_conditions: Quranic uses include treating a covenant or revealed book as of little account and formally notifying the other party that a peace agreement has been dissolved.

senses.definition: To withdraw, retire, or set oneself apart from others.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic construction describes deliberate withdrawal to a place apart or remote from one's people.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To neglect an affair or fail to carry it out.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative construction for treating an affair as disregarded or leaving it unperformed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To utter or put forth a saying.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use for producing a spoken expression, including a pleasing or well-formed saying.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To convey or offer a salutation or greeting to someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with a salutation or greeting as the thing cast or sent to another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To have something offered, presented, or placed in one's way.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive construction describing receipt of something as though it had been thrown to the recipient.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In an idiomatic expression, to praise the excellence of the mother who bore someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Restricted to the reported idiomatic phrase and not a general additional physical meaning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To prepare nabīdh by steeping dates, raisins, or similar ingredients in water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The liquid may be left to ferment and become intoxicating, but the preparation is also called nabīdh before fermentation reaches that stage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seethe or chafe against someone, figuratively likened to nabīdh boiling.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic comparison involving the beverage nabīdh.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pulsate, of a vein.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A dialectal form recorded as a variant of نَبَضَ, distinct from the casting root sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To conclude a sale through a throwing-based bargain, making the sale binding when one party throws the commodity, cloth, or a pebble.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The conventional transaction is called bayʿ al-munābadha and is described as a prohibited form of bargaining.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To withdraw apart in war or openly undertake hostilities against another party.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction can describe opposing parties retiring apart for war or declaring hostile intentions openly and equitably.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To act contrary, differently, or adversely to someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Equivalent to opposing or differing from the other party.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A small quantity, small number, or piece of something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a little amount or portion; the cited objects include property, herbage, rain, grey hair, and perfume, without restricting the meaning to those classes.

other_classical_meanings.definition: People of the baser sort; a mixed rabble or refuse of the people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural social description derived from the notion of something cast aside.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A position or place apart; by extension, sitting aside or apart.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested in the construction جَلَسَ نَبْذَةً, ‘he sat apart.’

other_classical_meanings.definition: Cast, thrown, or flung; something cast out.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A lexical equivalent of مَنْبُوذٌ in the reported usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Earth or dust thrown out from a hole or other excavation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized noun for the material removed and cast forth during digging.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A beverage made by steeping dates, raisins, honey, wheat, barley, or similar ingredients in water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term applies whether or not the drink has been left long enough to become intoxicating; its feminine noun نَبِيذَةٌ denotes a portion of it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cast-out child or foundling.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This use is recorded alongside the equivalent adjective مَنْبُوذٌ, with the naming motivated by being cast out.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who throws things away often or quickly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An agent noun describing repeated or rapid casting away.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who makes or sells nabīdh.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate occupational use of the same agent noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A pillow or cushion thrown onto the ground for sitting or reclining.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object is named for being thrown or placed down for use; its plural is مَنَابِذُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A child cast out in the road at birth and taken up and maintained by another; a foundling.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may also be extended to a bastard because such a child is imagined as cast away, though a foundling is not necessarily illegitimate.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A ewe or other animal rejected as unfit for eating because of extreme leanness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The designation is motivated by the animal being cast aside.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Apart or distant from other graves.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested in an alternative reading of a reported phrase about praying at a grave; the interpretation is spatial rather than the foundling sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Far from home or set apart and separate from others.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival or participial use describing a person located remotely or apart.

cautions: Historical Lane Quran citations are not converted directly into modern verse keys; modern locations used here are independently supplied by QAC, with Quranic interpretation also supported by the supplied Mufradat evidence.

Lane discusses a Form III construction at the Quranic treaty passage, while QAC assigns the attested Quran word to Form I; the construction is therefore retained as evidence for the Form I covenant-dissolution sense and its distinct Form III war usage is kept under Classical meanings.
